Lovely 3BR 2BA ranch, 410 Hillview Dr, Redwood City. Rent: $2,325/mo. Heat is gas. Resident pays gas, electric and water (about $55/mo water). Pets: dogs only, one pet max, 65 lbs max, pet rent $50, one-time pet fee $250. Fully fenced yard with gate. Application fee $42.50 per adult. Security deposit: 1.5 months. First and last month due at signing. Garage 2 cars included. Elementary school across the street (Hoover). Showings Sat 10-2.
